item.title: ON MY WHISTLE: The Realignment Recap
item.description: The UIL Realignment took center stage this week, putting the entire state of Texas on notice. High schools from every corner of the state learned their fate — who they’ll battle, where they’ll travel, and what the next few years will look like on the field and beyond. There’s no shortage of storylines coming out of the shakeup, and VYPE’s Matt Malatesta and Jackson DiPasquale break down every district, every move, and the impact it will have across the state.
